declarations.name: DiagramGrammar.matrix_hodge_conjugacy
declarations.type_signature_source:
theorem matrix_hodge_conjugacy
    {n0 n1 n2 : Type*} [Fintype n0] [Fintype n1] [Fintype n2]
    [DecidableEq n0] [DecidableEq n2]
    (A : Matrix n1 n0 ℂ) (B : Matrix n2 n1 ℂ)
    (U0 : Matrix n0 n0 ℂ) (U1 : Matrix n1 n1 ℂ) (U2 : Matrix n2 n2 ℂ)
    (h0 : U0ᴴ * U0 = 1) (h2 : U2ᴴ * U2 = 1) :
    (U1 * A * U0ᴴ) * (U1 * A * U0ᴴ)ᴴ +
      (U2 * B * U1ᴴ)ᴴ * (U2 * B * U1ᴴ) =
      U1 * (A * Aᴴ + Bᴴ * B) * U1ᴴ
declarations.kernel_printed_type:
DiagramGrammar.matrix_hodge_conjugacy.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {n0 : Type u_1} {n1 : Type u_2} {n2 : Type u_3} [Fintype n0]
  [Fintype n1] [Fintype n2] [DecidableEq n0] [DecidableEq n2] (A : Matrix n1 n0 ℂ) (B : Matrix n2 n1 ℂ)
  (U0 : Matrix n0 n0 ℂ) (U1 : Matrix n1 n1 ℂ) (U2 : Matrix n2 n2 ℂ) (h0 : U0.conjTranspose * U0 = 1)
  (h2 : U2.conjTranspose * U2 = 1) :
  U1 * A * U0.conjTranspose * (U1 * A * U0.conjTranspose).conjTranspose +
      (U2 * B * U1.conjTranspose).conjTranspose * (U2 * B * U1.conjTranspose) =
    U1 * (A * A.conjTranspose + B.conjTranspose * B) * U1.conjTranspose

theorem finite_fluid_energy_derivative
    (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (hJ : Jᵀ = -J)
    (D : Matrix m n ℝ) (L : Matrix p n ℝ) (ν : ℝ)
    (u : ℝ → n → ℝ) (force : n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ i, HasDerivAt (fun s => u s i)
      ((J *ᵥ u t - ν • ((Dᵀ * D) *ᵥ u t) - (Lᵀ * L) *ᵥ u t + force) i) t) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => kineticEnergy (u s))
      (u t ⬝ᵥ force - ν * ((D *ᵥ u t) ⬝ᵥ (D *ᵥ u t)) -
        (L *ᵥ u t) ⬝ᵥ (L *ᵥ u t)) t

  (u : ℝ → n → ℝ) (force : n → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
  (hu : ∀ (i : n), HasDerivAt (fun s => u s i) ((J *ᵥ u t - ν • (Dᵀ * D) *ᵥ u t - (Lᵀ * L) *ᵥ u t + force) i) t) :
  HasDerivAt (fun s => FluidInterfaces.kineticEnergy (u s))
    (u t ⬝ᵥ force - ν * D *ᵥ u t ⬝ᵥ D *ᵥ u t - L *ᵥ u t ⬝ᵥ L *ᵥ u t) t

declarations.name: FluidInterfaces.finite_fluid_work_identity
declarations.type_signature_source:
theorem finite_fluid_work_identity
    (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (hJ : Jᵀ = -J)
    (D : Matrix m n ℝ) (L : Matrix p n ℝ) (ν : ℝ)
    (u force : n → ℝ) :
    u ⬝ᵥ (J *ᵥ u - ν • ((Dᵀ * D) *ᵥ u) - (Lᵀ * L) *ᵥ u + force) =
      u ⬝ᵥ force - ν * ((D *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (D *ᵥ u)) -
        (L *ᵥ u) ⬝ᵥ (L *ᵥ u)
declarations.kernel_printed_type:
FluidInterfaces.finite_fluid_work_identity.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {n : Type u_1} {m : Type u_2} {p : Type u_3} [Fintype n]
  [Fintype m] [Fintype p] (J : Matrix n n ℝ) (hJ : Jᵀ = -J) (D : Matrix m n ℝ) (L : Matrix p n ℝ) (ν : ℝ)
  (u force : n → ℝ) :
